description: Cascades are wanted (D63, corrected by D65): cascades built to J25's design, cascade count and split distances as config keys with release values, receiving shaders for every shadowed material (units, terrain, trees, buildings, ships), no slicing artefacts and no sun-behind collapse across the scenario set (D12, D63), within the agreed budget (D64), whose row in perf/budgets.json this job marks agreed. Liam judged J25's sheets on 2026-11-06: they look the same to him, so stills cannot settle this. First, before the full build: a playable build with cascades switchable on and off, at a cascade size that beats J24's 8192 map (4096 or more; a 2048 cascade does not), for a sit-down playtest by Liam, cascades on against off; that playtest is the go or no-go, and it also covers shimmer. Alongside it, show on real ground that the sun-behind collapse goes (not shown by J25). Conditions from J25: the pick proved to a texel in map space, DXVK error counts on the cost arms.
title: Cascaded shadows build
